input.prompt: Speak as a warm, conversational Turkish narrator addressing one curious listener. Sound like a thoughtful person sharing a discovery as it becomes clear, with natural human cadence, varied sentence energy, and quiet curiosity. Let short reveal sentences land, then slow slightly for explanation. Use clear Istanbul Turkish diction and natural pauses. input.text: Ra'd yirmi yedinci ayet. وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْلَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْهِ ءَايَةٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُضِلُّ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَهْدِىٓ إِلَيْهِ مَنْ أَنَابَ
